description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for IPv6 neighbor management in Zephyr OS network stack.

methods.name: net_nbr_extra_data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the extra data associated with a neighbor entry.

methods.name: net_nbr_unref_debug
methods.description: Debug version of decrementing neighbor reference count, logs caller info.

methods.name: net_nbr_unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a neighbor, releases if count reaches zero.

methods.name: net_nbr_ref_debug
methods.description: Debug version of incrementing neighbor reference count, logs caller info.

methods.name: net_nbr_ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a neighbor.

methods.name: net_nbr_get
methods.description: Retrieves a free neighbor from the specified neighbor table.

methods.name: net_nbr_lookup
methods.description: Finds a neighbor in the table matching interface and link-layer address.

methods.name: net_nbr_link
methods.description: Links a neighbor to a link-layer address on a network interface.

methods.name: net_nbr_unlink
methods.description: Unlinks a neighbor from a link-layer address.

methods.name: net_nbr_get_lladdr
methods.description: Returns the link-layer address for a given index, or NULL if not available.

methods.name: net_nbr_clear_table
methods.description: Clears all neighbors from the neighbor table.

methods.name: net_nbr_print
methods.description: Prints neighbor table information for debugging.
